mesh.field_reconstruction: half_face_flux; top contact term averaged over full cell face h^2
mesh.storage: lossless gzip little-endian Float64/complex128; basis dimension is two outputs
mesh.side_bottom_boundary: insulating no outside faces; fixed 50mm cylinder staircase mask

definitions.analytic_gap: Euclidean distance between physical axis-aligned rectangles; mm
definitions.represented_support_gap: Signed minimum separation of entire contacted-cell bounding boxes; negative means overlap, zero includes touch; conservative numerical footprint, not physical gap
definitions.centre_distance: Minimum XY distance between actual contacted native-cell centres; zero for a shared tissue top DOF
definitions.shared_tissue_DOF: Distinct physical metal pads retain separate contact edges; shared tissue node is not a claim of a metal short
definitions.fragments: Stored positive overlaps are retained verbatim; omitted positive intersections are separately counted; numeric bins are not safety limits

nearest_analytic_pad_edge.interpretation: XY projection only; native tissue cell center is not a contact-edge surface sample

normal_J_RMS_max_location.representation: density is constant on this saved physical pad/top-cell overlap; tissue face center and clipped physical patch centroid are distinct

contact_voltage_RMS_max_location.representation: density is constant on this saved physical pad/top-cell overlap; tissue face center and clipped physical patch centroid are distinct

definitions.normal_J: sqrt(sum actual four spectral lines |c_f @ density_basis_f|² /2), A/m²; contact-area-weighted P95
definitions.contact_voltage: sqrt(sum actual f |specific_Z_area(f) * normal_density(f)|² /2), V; exact saved interface model
definitions.interface: existing config z.f.re/im in ohm*m² reused verbatim; no additional Rs subtraction or contact-area scaling
definitions.uncertainty: PBS-derived modeled interface, not experimentally validated skin contact; not a safety limit
definitions.locations: native overlap patches; no assumed coincidence of contact J and voltage maxima, no converged edge maximum claim
